title: eval-harness suite schema
description: The shape of an eval suite for a domain skill: a set of cases, each run twice (with the skill and without), graded against the same structural assertions. Assertions test structure and discipline — a dated check, a named evidence tier — never frozen values, because the load-bearing facts of a domain skill are often dated negatives that a single event flips.

notes.description: Protocol for running and grading the suite. Each case runs twice — once with the skill loaded, once without — and both outputs are graded against the same assertions. Grading is judgment, not a script. Archive a full real graded run as a dated sample output.

name.description: kebab-case slug that names the capability or discipline the case gates

should_trigger.description: true when the case verifies the skill activates at all (not just that an answer is correct)

prompt.description: The user question, in as raw a form as a real user would type. Tests trigger, routing, and accessibility, not idealized phrasing.

expected_output.description: What a correct answer looks like — structure, decomposition, honesty flags. Not a script; the human grader reads it to calibrate.

assertions.description: Pass/fail criteria graded against BOTH runs. Structural and discipline-based: a dated check, a named evidence tier, a named procedure. Never 'the price is X' — values drift and assertions must survive flips.

files.description: Skill files (or SKILL.md) that ground this case, relative to the repo root. Assert that the grader loads them for the with-skill run.
